Subject: Audit kickoff — SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ evidence request and IR playbook

Hi Ben,

Hope you’re well. We’re kicking off our SOC 2 readiness audit the week of 2026-11-01 and our auditor has asked for a handful of items from Redwood in advance to scope the work. High level ask:

- A copy of your Incident Response Plan (SIG/CAIQ-relevant controls) and any recent post-incident writeups for the last 12 months.
- Telemetry extracts showing auth + privilege changes, retention policy, and an S3 access log sample for 2026-09-30 to 2026-10-07.
- Evidence of SOC-related control ownership (owner names, last test dates) and any runbooks used during incidents.
- A short statement on how you handle forensic artifact redaction / PII minimization for customer-facing evidence.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
1) Provide a redacted telemetry bundle (we prefer CSV/JSON samples)
2) Share a redacted postmortem for a relevant incident in the last 12 months
3) Complete the CAIQ questions we’ll send next week (we’ll provide a spreadsheet)

We generally need the files by 2026-10-18 to give the auditor time to catalogue items before the fieldwork week. If there are any contractual/legal gating items please flag them.

Thanks — would you be available for a 30-minute sync tomorrow to align on delivery?

Best,
Emily Rivera
Senior Security Manager, DataFlow Systems
emily.rivera@dataflow.com

Emily — thanks for the clear list. We can support this scope and I’ve outlined a proposed handoff below.

What we can provide by 2026-10-18:
- A redacted Incident Response Playbook (PDF) covering detection, escalation, containment, communication, and evidence handling. See attached: dataflow_soc2_irp_v2.pdf (redacted).
- A redacted postmortem from an authentication incident in 2026-03 (sanitized timelines & affected tenant IDs removed).
- Telemetry extract (sample CSV) for the 2026-09-30 to 2026-10-07 window; full telemetry zip (telemetry-extract-20261010.zip) requires a controlled transfer — see notes below.
- Control ownership matrix (redaction-friendly) and runbook index; will provide as an XLSX.

Redaction and transfer notes:
- We will remove PII and customer identifiers per our evidence redaction policy. I’ve attached a proposed redaction matrix (redaction-matrix.xlsx) describing fields we redact and why.
- For the full telemetry bundle we will provide an encrypted archive via a secure link (S3 presigned, one-time access) and DocuSign for the evidence transfer checklist. The auditor will need to sign the evidence handling attestation (we can route via DocuSign: DSIGN-82471).

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll share the redacted IR playbook and the sample telemetry in the next email (ETA: today EOD).
2) Let’s do the 30-minute sync at 09:30 PT tomorrow to confirm scope and recipients for the encrypted bundle.

If you need anything narrower (e.g., only CAIQ mapping without telemetry) tell me and we’ll prioritize.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
